author: FirstSintax
body:
Is it considered team grief if someone builds a house and I fill it with wood?

I mean, the house has no strategical advantage, its just right outside of spawn.

Shouldnt they get punished for team grief by blocking 70% of spawn with an uglyass house?

replies.author: Posighdun
replies.body: Well, technically yes. It's ok if someone builds a house near spawn, as long as people can get out of spawn.
